scope: Synthetic, one host, unit-level memoryStub for the current rule; paired test-only predicate for the overlap-first variant.
multipleReasons: All 204 combined no overlap and amount outside tolerance. Edited dates are drawn from 0–3 days, so outside-window cases cannot occur.
authoredAssumptions: All pairs have the same hospital and service and use one synthetic subject. The variant also requires distinct episode IDs and inclusive stay overlap and ignores billing amount.
Edited duplicates shift the whole stay and service date forward uniformly by 0–3 days; authored amount change is uniformly 1–10% with equally likely direction, truncated to minor units.
Original benign repeats have uniform 1–90-day service gaps and bills 70–130% of the first bill. The three-day subset is small.

Readmission gaps are measured from discharge to the next admission. The generator draws 80% from 1–14 days and 20% from 15–90 days, uses the same bill and stay distributions as benign repeats, and enforces no stay overlap. Zero under the variant follows from the generator and the predicate.
Stay duration, amounts, hospital and service concentration, and prevalence are synthetic. No real-world referral or fraud rate is estimated.
